subject.title: [Feature Request] Unified Built-in Sandbox with Multi-Platform Support and Tiered Presets

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella for OpenClaw sandbox/isolation architecture, or should maintainers split it now into separate milestone issues for defaults, plugin/process isolation, IPC, manifest policy, credential scoping, and resource limits?
rationale: The remaining work defines OpenClaw's security boundary and public config/plugin contracts, and current main only has opt-in tool sandbox groundwork.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, then open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin Isolation
options.body: Retitle and scope this issue to native plugin/process and credential isolation while leaving preset UX and tool sandboxing to narrower related issues.

options.title: Defer Broad Architecture
options.body: Leave current opt-in tool sandboxing as the supported posture until a maintainer sponsors secure-by-default isolation work.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, then open maintainer-owned design or milestone issues for each security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the live keep-open review and recent sandbox/config/docs history.
